title: RBX Agent Domain Contract
description: Runtime execution scope and authority for an RBX agent in a given mission or role. Extends the agent manifest with permissions evaluated at mission and session level. Permissions only narrow down the agent hierarchy — they never expand (sub-agent scope non-escalation invariant).

domain.description: Primary domain. Agent must not accept sessions outside this domain without explicit orchestrator authorization.

allowed_repositories.description: Git repository names this agent may access. Empty means read-only access to no repositories.

allowed_tools.description: Tool IDs this agent may invoke. Any tool not listed is blocked by the Sandbox Gate.

allowed_memory_scopes.description: Memory scopes this agent may read from and write to.

allowed_session_types.description: Session types this agent may operate in.

authority_level.description: Authority ceiling. Effective permission = min(authority_level_ceiling, declared_field). observer=read-only; advisor=recommend only; executor=act within scope; orchestrator=spawn/coordinate; governor=validate/veto.

can_orchestrate_subagents.description: May spawn and coordinate sub-agents. Requires authority_level: orchestrator. Sub-agents receive intersection of orchestrator and sub-agent contracts (scope non-escalation).

can_modify_code.description: May edit source files in allowed_repositories.

can_create_commits.description: May create local git commits. Requires can_modify_code: true.

can_push.description: May push to remote. Requires can_create_commits: true. Each push also requires explicit per-operation operator authorization in the current message — this field is necessary but not sufficient.

can_deploy.description: May trigger deployment pipelines. Requires can_push: true and a passed human_approval gate declared in requires_human_approval_for.

requires_human_approval_for.description: Action types that always require an explicit human approval gate before execution, regardless of other conditions. Common values: git_push, deploy, merge_to_main, delete_branch.

output_types.description: Expected output types this agent may produce in this domain. Examples: code_diff, test_results, review_comments, architecture_proposal, adr_draft.

forbidden_actions.description: Actions explicitly prohibited. Not delegatable to sub-agents. Examples: modify_secrets, delete_branch, force_push, approve_own_output.

review_requirements.description: Declares which output types require review before being acted on, by whom, and with what minimum reviewer count.

reviewer_domains.description: Domain(s) the reviewer must belong to.

min_reviewers.description: Minimum number of independent reviewers required.

blocking.description: If true, execution is paused until review completes.

governance_policy_refs.description: IDs of rbx-governance policies that apply to this contract. Referenced policies must be in 'accepted' status at mission creation time.

notes.description: Optional human-readable notes about this contract's scope or constraints.
